item.title: Show #22 - Big Cuppa Radio - Nov 2026
item.description:
November is here, GTA 6 is nearly here, and more importantly, Episode 22 of Big Cuppa Radio is here 😁
Come on a journey through swamp rock, Algerian raï and Kwaito, with some questionable thoughts and musings along the way.
Lots of love to all of you. 📡📻☢️

item.title: Show #21 - Big Cuppa Radio - Oct 2026
item.description:
Latest instalment from the Big Cuppa basement has got a bit of everything: bit of desert blues from Algeria, some Cameroonian Funk, bit of Brook calling the Scottish pussies - it's a ride! 📡📻☢️
Tracklists as ever are over on the Patreon, along with extended shows, collaborative playlists and a whole load of other fun: https://www.patreon.com/cw/BigCuppaRadio
Love to all listeners - long live the radio!

item.title: Show #20 - Big Cuppa Radio - Sep 2026
item.description:
Episode 20!! 🎉🍾🙌 A landmark ep that I didn’t even realise I was making until I uploaded it!
Thank you all for joining me on this journey. Still loving making radio and really enjoying the engagement the show and clips are getting these days.
As ever, tracklists, playlists and bonus episodes are over on Patreon (https://www.patreon.com/cw/BigCuppaRadio). Massive thanks to every single one of the Patreons. Dream is still to make more of these so keep telling your friends!

item.title: Show #19- Big Cuppa Radio - July 2026
item.description:
A few days late with July's instalment! Sorry folks but at least we've got a corker for you! 📻📡❤️
We've got call ins, we've got highlife, we've got funk, we've got a lot of Pat Thomas - we've got all sorts!
If you want tracklists, extra episodes, Spotify playlists and anything else you can dream of, do jump on to the Patreon! https://patreon.com/BigCuppaRadio?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_fan&utm_content=copyLink
Love you all.

item.title: Show #18 - Big Cuppa Radio - June 2026
item.description:
Welcome to the sunny July transmission from the Big Cuppa Basement 📻📡☀️
We've got, as ever, an eclectic selection of tunes for you from all over the world.
You've got 50 minutes here FREE on mixcloud, for the full hour and half show join us over on Patreon! https://www.patreon.com/cw/BigCuppaRadio
Love you all 🙌❤️

item.title: WORLD CUPPA RADIO #1 - (full 80min show on Patreon)
item.description:
Football adjacent music (and football centric music) from all over the world! Absolutely buzzing!! 🌍🏆⚽️
Full show, including some absolutely outrageous callers is over on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/BigCuppaRadio/posts/world-cuppa-1-160757679

item.title: Show #17 - Big Cuppa Radio - May 2026
item.description:
Our most requested guest came back on the show this month 🙌. Peggy joined me for an ever eclectic selection of worldwide bangers! Enjoy!
(and keep your eyes peeled for my world cup focussed shows, World Cuppa Radio!, should be coming out next week).

item.title: Show #16 - Big Cuppa Radio - April 2026
item.description:
Show 16 from the Big Cuppa basement/sub marine. An especially eclectic selection of music for you this month - from South Africa to New Zealand, to the Golan Heights in Syria. Tasty stuff.
Let me know where you're listening from! 🌎📡❤️

item.title: Show #15 - Big Cuppa Radio - March 2026
item.description:
Trying to keep things light this month with all the craziness going on in the world! Strap in for upbeat, eclectic tunes from all over the world 📡🎙️🌎.
Also I'm joined by a pasty, pasty guest in the studio with me for the second half, Factor Fiddy, who brings along not only a lovely selection of tunes but also a bottle of tequilla for the both of us. Lovely stuff.
Enjoying getting messages from people telling me where in the world they're listening! Keep that coming. From the basement to the 🌎!
Much love.

item.title: Show #14 - Big Cuppa Radio - Feb 2026
item.description:
This month's episode takes us all over! We honour Ebo Taylor's passing, enjoy the self-help-comedy-pop of 80's icon Will Powers, and are led in some rather unusual directions by some pretty strange callers!
Show is, as ever, presented by Brook Driver, with additional writing from Cory Poppins and Victor Hampson.

item.title: Show #13 - Big Cuppa Radio - Jan 2026
item.description:
Episode 13 of Big Cuppa radio brings, as ever, an eclectic selection of under appreciated bangers from all over the world. As with every show, we're genre curious and intermittently interspersed with call-ins and musings from the host, Brook.
If you enjoy the show please do share with your nan and let us know where in the world you're listening from! 🌍
Presenter: Brook Driver Written by: Brook Driver, Cory Poppins

item.title: Show #12 - Big Cuppa Radio - December 2025
item.description: Bringing in one year of Big Cuppa Radio with a special guest down here in the basement - the one and only Matt Bayfield of Purple City Records. Expect eclectic selections and home hot, hot takes...

item.title: Show #11 - Big Cuppa Radio - Nov 2025
item.description: Comedy, Soul, Leftfield Pop

item.title: Show #10 - Big Cuppa Radio - October 2025 (ft. Peggy)
item.description:
Got the guest on this month that everyone’s been requesting! - my five-year-old Peggy. We talk K-pop Demon Hunters, trees, sea-creatures (all the big topics) and then she gets bored and leaves…
Plenty of great music for you to feast your ears on. And keep sending me music you think I’d like, I’m enjoying getting those recommendations!

item.title: Show #9 - Big Cuppa Radio - September 2025 (ft. Sean Burke)
item.description: This month's show we get a real life comedian joining us down in the Big Cuppa Basement (skip to 26.30 to hear Sean Burke's dulcet Irish tones). Plenty of great music to share, with a lot of love this month for the legend that is Eddy Grant. Go listen to Sean's own podcast 'How to Steal a Penguin' here: https://tinyurl.com/4bvb9zz4 (it's a great listen!)

item.title: Show #8 - Big Cuppa Radio - August 2025
item.description: Highlife, Funk, Comedy

item.title: Show #7 - Big Cuppa Radio - June 2025
item.description: The 7th instalment of Big Cuppa Radio fuses Highlife, Boogie and Arabic pop, with musings about p*do musicians and call ins from Spanish porn stars....

item.title: Show #6 - Big Cuppa Radio - May 2025
item.description:
First time I've posted an episode LATE! 😬
Good show though this one. Couple of call ins, some funky stuff from Yoko Ono and even some CONTROVERSIAL OPINIONS for you to sink your ears into.
If you do enjoy the show please share it with your mother or father in law. It really helps!

item.title: Show #5 - Big Cuppa Radio - April 2025 (ft. Cory P)
item.description:
This month we have our first in-person guest on the show! (skip to 34mins if you're only interested in that).
For those who are here for the lot, we’ve got Somalian disco, we’ve got Ween, we’ve got musings on the cultural impact of Simply Red and riveting debates on whether Mick Hucknall has had sex with more women than any ginger in history… The show's really got it all.
If you enjoy, please do share with anyone you think might like. All the love ❤️

item.title: Show #4 - Big Cuppa Radio - March 2025
item.description:
March's instalment. Featuring musings on social justice warriors, an angry caller and some red hot tunes. 📻
(messed up the export first time so have re-uploaded!)
